title: Paralegal: Practical Static Analysis for Privacy Bugs
problem: Privacy bugs in software systems are difficult to detect through traditional testing; static analysis tools need practical techniques that scale to real codebases and accurately identify privacy violations.
motivation: Automated privacy bug detection can significantly reduce security vulnerabilities and compliance issues in production systems.
method: Paralegal scans code without running it (static analysis) to find where private data might leak or be accessed by people who shouldn't have it. It works by tracking how sensitive information flows through your code—where it originates, where it travels, and who can access it at each point—to catch when data leaks out or is used improperly. The system is designed to scale across large, real-world codebases, not just small examples.
key_novelty: Paralegal uses static analysis—scanning code without running it—to find privacy bugs in real-world software at scale.
contributions: Scalable static analysis for privacy vulnerability detection
Privacy bug classification and severity assessment

metrics.other: Privacy bug detection accuracy and false positive rates

limitations: False positives/negatives are inherent to static analysis; requires developer validation.
